findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can miss exceptions and the thread can loop forever.
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and then checks `caughtExceptions` straight away. It never waits for the reader thread. A request that is still running when the flag flips, which is the window most likely to hit a deleted group, can add its exception after `assertThat` has already passed, so the test can miss the NPE it is meant to catch. If any `remove()` call throws, `deletedAll.set(true)` never runs and the reader thread keeps calling the admin API with no end, still running after the test and realm cleanup finish. Keep the `Thread` reference, put the deletes in `try { ... } finally { deletedAll.set(true); }`, and call `thread.join()` before the assertion. Making it a daemon thread would also help.

held.title: getSubGroupsCount can now return null, and a caller that unboxes it would throw an NPE.
held.body: When the group was deleted at the same time, `getSubGroupsCount()` now returns a null `Long` where it used to fail inside the adapter. Any caller that unboxes the result, such as `group.getSubGroupsCount() > 0` or assigning it to a `long`, then throws an NPE in a different place, so the fix only moves the crash. I could not see the callers, including what was removed from `GroupUtils`. Check that every caller handles null, or skip deleted groups before calling this method.
